decisions.reason: Identifying the switched 5V boost load as sensors does not change the battery connector or its NTC connection.
The boost converter's sensor load does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The source identifies loads powered by the 5V boost and does not change battery temperature sensing through the J_BAT NTC.
The powered-load clarification has no effect on the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
The boost converter's powered-load category does not change I2C cable length, clock speed, or pull-up resistance.
